Numbers: about 2 h wall clock (21:46 to about 23:45 UTC before land: 13 min cold composer install, 2 min apt MariaDB); 8 tasks, all solo, no delegation, no failed attempts. Walk at 321eca8e: steps 1-5 pass, 2,424 orders shipped with 0 failed on --tries=3, replayed import 422, resume once; no findings; ideas #PW6ADS8P (the modal reads 'The upload failed.' for that 422) and #70FEZAVB (Action Events shows no ip or user agent). Plan corrections: #ZSNA5Y6B (422 also for queued and failed imports), #80HCG1DE (fold reads the model's connection, case only), #7BKQ09AC (a queued standalone run has total 1), #2KYGF0MG (a bulk run has no run page), #HCF9C96S (Action Events shows no user agent).
